site_name: Ailsa Wharf, Ailsa Street, London, E14
description: Redevelopment of the Site for a mixed-use scheme providing 952 residential units; 1,555 sqm GIA commercial floorspace (Use Class E) within a series of buildings up to 23 storeys; the creation of a new access road and the realignment of Ailsa Street; the provision of safeguarded land for a bridge landing; the provision of cycle and car parking spaces; and associated Site-wide landscaping and public realm works.This application is accompanied by an Environmental Statement.
